recentItems.title: Samay | সময় | Sumon Kalyan Dutta (SKD) | Lyton | RJ Shubhankar | New Assamese Song 2024
recentItems.description:
Immerse yourself in the heartfelt beauty of "Samay," a soulful track by Sumon Kalyan Dutta (SKD). Written by RJ Shubhankar and brought to life with music by SKD and LYTON, this sentimental regional pop gem captures the essence of fleeting moments and deep emotions. Let the evocative melodies and touching lyrics resonate with you.

Subscribe now @saregamaregional

থমকি থমকি 
সময়ে কয়
ওভতনিৰ বাট নাই…
হেৰুৱা সময়ৰ টোপোলাটিত
সুৰবোৰ আজি চোন নাই…

কোন অচিনা দেশ
তোৰেযে ঠিকনা হ’ল…
সেই সোণালী সময়
এৰি থৈ আঁতৰি গ'ল…

আমিয়ে সজোৱা 
গানবোৰৰ
ছন্দ পাবলে নাই…
তোৰে ঐ সতে যেন
গুছি গ’ল

সেই তাড়নাতে যে
উশাহ হেৰাই
মোৰ গানে…
সুৰ বিচাৰি 
উকা জীৱন
আজিহে পাই…
থমকি থমকি 
সময়ে কয়
ওভতনিৰ বাট নাই…
তইচোন কাষতে 
আজি নাই নাই
হঁহিটিও যেন হেৰাই…

জোন হেৰুৱা বাট
তোৰে ঐ জোনাকী  হ’ল…
মোৰ আকাশত

English Translation:
"English Translation of this song :

Pausing, hesitating,
Time whispers,
There’s no path to return…
In the bundle of lost moments,
The melodies, it seems, have vanished…

Some unknown land,
Has become your new home…
That golden time,
Has slipped away, leaving me behind…

The rhythms of the songs,
We once created,
Can no longer be found…
As if, with you,
They too have faded away,
Bidding a silent goodbye…
In that restless chase,
My breath falters,
My song remains incomplete…
Searching for a tune,
This empty life,
Is all that’s left today…

Pausing, hesitating,
Time whispers,
There’s no path to return…
You’re no longer here,
Not by my side today,
Even your laughter feels distant, lost…

The path where the moon was lost,
Has now become your guiding light…
In my sky,
Only endless darkness remains…"
